facts.big: going to + verbo · -er than · more + adjetivo
facts.label: Planos e cores
facts.sub: Use going to para planos e comparativos para cores: I’m going to paint my bedroom. Blue is calmer than red. Dark paint is more expensive.

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Use am/is/are going to + verbo para planos: I’m going to paint my bedroom. We’re going to finish by Sunday. Para negar, use not: I’m not going to paint the ceiling.

facts.label: Comparativos
facts.sub: Compare adjetivos curtos com -er than: bright vira brighter, dark vira darker, tall vira taller. Blue is calmer than red. Se terminar em e, acrescente só r.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “mais claro que” e “mais caro que”.

compare.us: Em inglês: brighter than, darker than, more expensive than. Use -er com palavras curtas e more com palavras longas. Para planos, use going to.
